prompt: Create a transparent-background pixel-art atlas with exactly two rows and six square columns. Row 1 is the parade staging platform from source 1, row 2 the unoccupied parade float base from source 2. Each row has six fixed-axis orthographic views ordered FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. Preserve each exact source object, no prop substitutions or decorations beyond what its source contains. Row 1: small raised white-and-gold parade presentation platform with central steps, red/gold draped front and two vertical red/gold banners at the rear corners. Top view must show horizontal platform deck, stair treads and banner post-foot footprints, not full vertical banners. Side views show consistent low platform height and stairs; bottom is the underside/support outline, no banners protruding upward. Row 2: low gold-trimmed unoccupied red draped parade cart on four small gold wheels. Top is the flat cart platform and curtain edge footprint; front/rear broad decorative skirt; right/left narrow cart ends with wheel profiles; bottom shows axle and wheel underside, no vertical curtain face viewed upward. Orthographic, no perspective/isometric, no labels/text/grid/background, full centered uncropped objects, transparent gutters.
